verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing and Transactional REST APIs expose core operations programmatically, which makes scripted, UI-free automation plausible. These include adding contacts, sending campaigns, generating account exports and sending messages, plus webhooks for event-driven flows. However, the evidence shows no CLI, CI-specific tooling or guidance, so headless use means building custom API integrations. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs/examples, documented non-interactive auth (API keys/service accounts) for pipelines, hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
